title: A whole picture allows changing conditions

captions.physics: Relating an explanation’s parts with direction
captions.energy: Gathering experience into a coherent whole
captions.emotions: Feeling change within an understood picture

meaning: Your shared view can preserve coherence when examination distinguishes an understood relationship from conditions that may change.
text: A whole picture need not remain identical under every condition. The Chariot in the physical position of Ajna directs how parts of an explanation are related. The World in energy supports gathering experience into a coherent whole. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions feels change within an understood picture. Your view can hold a discovered relationship while noticing movement in surrounding conditions, allowing understanding to remain substantial without becoming a promise of repetition.

For example, you investigate why a familiar route sometimes feels short and sometimes long. You compare waiting for transport, the number of stops and impressions of the journey. **Wholeness in understanding allows conditions to change within the picture.** A relationship becomes visible: the felt duration involves several parts whose proportions vary. Different impressions now fit one explanation. Nevertheless, the next journey may still surprise you. Your shared view gains coherence without promising advance knowledge of how travelling a familiar route will feel every time.

The risk is treating a discovered relationship as a formula that must predict every impression. Changing conditions then seem to destroy the entire picture. Gathering experience as a whole helps include this limit too. An explanation relates examined parts while a new case contributes material. Directed inquiry retains substance when the shared picture can expand and distinguish an understood connection from a guarantee of repetition.
